worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections per worker process. Increase for high-concurrency deployments.

keepalive_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for keep-alive connections to upstream gRPC servers.

stream_upstreams.description: List of TCP upstream blocks for raw gRPC (non-HTTP/2) load balancing.

name.description: Unique name of the upstream group.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the gRPC backend.

extra_directives.description: Additional directives for this upstream block (e.g., 'least_conn;', 'hash $remote_addr consistent;').

stream_servers.description: List of TCP server blocks to proxy raw gRPC traffic (non-HTTP/2).

name.description: Human-readable identifier for the server block.

port.description: Port to listen on for incoming gRPC traffic.

proxy_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for proxy connection to backend.

proxy_responses.description: Number of responses to read from upstream before acknowledging client (for gRPC this is usually 1).

upstream.description: Name of the upstream block to proxy to (must match a `stream_upstreams.name`).
